title: What are Enums?
overview: Enums in TypeScript allow developers to define a set of named constants. They make code more readable by replacing hard-coded values with meaningful names.

example.title: Enum Example

title: Numeric Enums
overview: Numeric enums store values as numbers. TypeScript automatically assigns numeric values starting from zero unless specified manually.

title: String Enums
overview: String enums allow developers to assign custom string values to enum members. They are easier to debug and understand.

title: Enums in React Native
overview: Enums are useful in React Native for managing fixed values like user roles, screen names, app states, and configuration options.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how enums create named constant values, different enum types, and how they improve readability in TypeScript applications.
